meta.name: Badi Heroine Banti Hai
meta.description:
In the vibrant world of Veer Singhania Designs, Kajal, a spirited dreamer from Punjab, collides with the monochromatic existence of Advait, the workaholic CEO. In a chic world where bullets and murders are as fashionable as love itself, will Kajal-Advait find true love or will they become a victim of their own misunderstandings & prejudice?

Rated U/A 16+ · Returning Series · First aired 19 Jan 2024 · India · Language: Hindi
Studio: Gen-K Studios · Network: Amazon miniTV

Not complete. On your server: S1 14/15 (missing E2) | S2 10/10

On your server — Audio: Hindi

videos.title: Jab Advait Met Kajal
videos.overview: Kajal and Advait are introduced.They hail from different places.Kajal happens to work under Advait who owns a fashion company.Kajal somehow is attracted to Advait but Advait finds kajal stupid.

videos.title: Hum Aapke Dad Ke Hai Kaun?
videos.overview: Advait is totally astounded to find out about Kajal's ownership of the company.He concludes that she was Veer's mistress.He asks Kajal to hand him over the company but she denies because she is hurt.

videos.title: Kissaqzaade!
videos.overview: Escaping from the media Advait rushes Kajal to a bar. Being irritated with Advait's accusations Kajal shows him how she must have seduced his father which ends up in some heated scenes between them.

videos.title: Mujhse Shaadi Kyun Karogi?
videos.overview: Advait tries to blackmail Kajal from their scene in the Bar which got recorded. The media reaches Kajal's building and Kajal declares about her being engaged to Advait as a revenge to him.

videos.title: Japs Ne Bana Di Jodi
videos.overview: Advait finally gets the ownership of his company back.But he realizes the papers he got signed are invalid. Later Advait and Kajal had to act as engaged couple in front of Japanese cohort.

videos.title: Deal-Waale Dulhaniya Le Jayenge
videos.overview: Despite initial skepticism, Kajal convinces the Japanese cohort to engage in a deal with VSD.That mysterious masked man is seen around the fashion show and again an incident takes a place.

videos.title: Mask-Man Na Milega Dobara
videos.overview: In a twist, Advait and Kajal seek refuge, but tragedy strikes when Kajal sees the masked man firing at Advait, she pushes Advait and takes the bullet for him. Later Advait brings her home to recover.

videos.title: Hum Deal De Chuke Sanam
videos.overview: Advait wakes up from a sound and comes out of his bedroom and he sees in the kitchen that Kajal is cooking .An intruder enters the house and shuts the lights out,sending Advait into a panic attack.

videos.title: Jab We Fight
videos.overview: Advait and Arjun came to know about their father's demise.Police accuses kajal of murdering their father .

videos.title: Saawan-Iya
videos.overview: A sudden realization hits Advait that Kajal might be innocent, prompting him to reconsider the accusations. Advait and Arjun work together to clear Kajal's name by proving someone else framed her.

videos.title: Love, Dhamki Aur Dhoka!
videos.overview: Someone is blackmailing Arjun and asking for a lot of money saying she has the pic of Advait's mom's extra marital affairs. Arjun agreed to pay a significant amount to the Blackmailer.

videos.title: Kabhi Khushi Kabhi Jurm
videos.overview: Advait comes to know the whole story of blackmailing. From Arjun he comes to know that Kajal knew about this blackmailing thing. Advait misunderstands that it is Kajal who has leaked these photographs.

videos.title: Main Blame Ki Diwani Hu!
videos.overview: Arjun comes to know that the money was not debited from his bank account, hence the blackmailer had given the photos to the media. Arjun comes to know that the woman blackmailing Arjun was Sonam.

videos.title: Video Ke Side Effects
videos.overview: The revelation about kajal's innocence came too late as the video had played which Advait planned for kajal's humiliation as revenge. Kajal slaps Advait. Later kajal takes over VSD for revenge.

videos.title: Silly-Sila
videos.overview: Arjun warns Advait of unintended love as GPS links Sonam to Veer, sparking intrigue. Kajal seizes VSD, forcing Advait into a public confession. Stakes rise in a thrilling battle for power and redemption.

videos.title: Tu Joothi Main Berozgaar
videos.overview: As Advait copes with Kajal's move, tensions rise over the video's origin. Despite her claims, Advait's skepticism grows as GPS reveals truths. In Veer's cabin, Kajal's quest unveils alliances, escalating suspense.

videos.title: Killer Ho Naa Ho
videos.overview: Advait guides Kajal through dark corridors, pursued by a lurking shadow. Rushing to safety, they face a deadly showdown as the killer's bullet pierces the air, plunging them into a gripping battle for survival.

videos.title: Maine Attack Kiya
videos.overview: In a deadly inferno, Advait saves Kajal, rushed to safety. Police pursue the killer. Sonam's fate hangs by a thread, and Anastasia's quest for Veer's phone takes a dark turn, keeping the audience on edge for the final revelation.

videos.title: Will Chahta Hai
videos.overview: Anastasia plots with Veer's phone, adding pressure to Kajal before her show. GPS's suspicions uncover a video twist with consequences, setting the stage for dramatic events as alliances shift and secrets unravel.

videos.title: Kuch Toh Troll Kahenge
videos.overview: Kajal is betrayed by Advait after her dream is shattered, leading to a frantic search and dramatic confrontation.

videos.title: Pyaar Ishq Aur Paps
videos.overview: In Punjab, tensions rise as Advait grapples with feelings for Kajal midst his engagement prep with Anna, whose motives are suspect. A surprise arrival and a shocking truth set the stage for drama

videos.title: Ek Vivaah... Kaisa Bhi
videos.overview: Amidst GP-Ana tension, Kajal's arrival ignites emotions. Advait confronts his feelings and unexpected engagement, leading to shocking revelations and a climactic moment with consequences.

videos.title: Yeh Raaste Hai Mask Ke
videos.overview: Despite challenges, Advait secures Kajal's successful fashion show, but Ana's presence foreshadows danger midst Kajal's victory

videos.title: Kaafi Kuch Hota Hai
videos.overview: Amidst attack, love confessions, and a heroic rescue, Kajal and Advait's bond strengthens, marking a turning point.
